items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: After Rene A. They play the next fella playing the next on down.

ctx.x: Buddy P.T., Sam Morgan, you know, they'd be bucking against one of them. One right behind them, one band on a big truck or something like that.

After Rene A. They play the next fella playing the next on down. So we was out of town dudes. We was hung on the last truck behind. Free music. That was in 1914. That was in 1914. I remember it coming to me. Mm-hm. We'd be bucking against one another, one right behind her and one band on a big truck or something like that. After Rene played the next fella playing the next on down. So we was out of town dudes, we was hung on the last truck behind. Free music. That was in 1914. I remember it coming to me.
What about the storm? Where were you when they had the big storm there?
